import sys,time,json,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import *
N=8192
ev=[{'keys':['A']}]+[datagram(envelope('A',i%65536,b'\x01'),(0,)) for i in range(N)]

inp=json.dumps({'traces':[tr]})
print('input bytes',len(inp))
t=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=inp.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=180);print('elapsed',time.time()-t,'rc',p.returncode,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:200])
if p.returncode==0:
 o=json.loads(p.stdout)['traces'][0];print(len(o['packets']),len(o['datagrams']),o['packets'][-1],o['received'])
